data.description:
**Change the future with us.**

We are looking for dedicated and talented people who tackle ever-changing challenges, customer needs, and questions from colleagues with clever concepts and creativity. We embrace change and work with curious minds re-inventing the future of work. Join us and let us focus together on what’s truly important: making lives better with new ideas and the latest technology around the world.

**What will you do?**

**Position Overview**

The **Senior Business Data Analyst** translates business needs into scalable, high-quality data and analytics solutions.

This is a hands-on senior analytics role combining strong business ownership with technical depth. You will work directly with stakeholders to understand business problems, clarify outcomes and requirements, investigate data, generate insights, and deliver analytical products from discovery through implementation.

You will join the Smart Infrastructure, Asset Management Software Information Technology (SI AMS IT) Data & AI team and work across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and other commercial functions. Marketing will be an important area of focus, making previous experience in Marketing Analytics or related commercial domains particularly valuable.

The role offers significant ownership and visibility within a small, collaborative Data & AI team. You will work with modern technologies including Snowflake, dbt, SQL, Python, Power BI, and Qlik, while contributing to the continued evolution of our analytics, data products, and AI capabilities. We expect you to be an early adopter of generative AI, using it to accelerate delivery and expand into adjacent technical areas.

This role is ideal for an experienced analyst who enjoys owning the full analytics lifecycle, from understanding business problems and defining requirements through data modeling, analysis, visualization, and stakeholder adoption.

**RESPONSIBILITIES | You’ll make an impact by:**

**Business Partnership and Requirements Engineering**

- Partner with business stakeholders to understand problems, desired outcomes, success criteria, and business value.
- Handle ongoing business requests as a trusted partner, not a ticket taker, focusing on the business need behind each ask.
- Translate business needs into clear, actionable data and analytics requirements.
- Resolve missing or ambiguous requirements and break larger problems into manageable use cases.
- Build strong understanding of assigned business domains, processes, metrics, and business logic.
- Lead discovery, solution demonstrations, validation, and business sign off for assigned use cases.
- Collaborate with global stakeholders across North America and Europe, with core working hours aligned to Eastern Time business operations.

  

**Data Analysis and Insight Generation**

- Extract, combine, analyze, and validate complex datasets using advanced SQL and analytical tools.
- Identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and actionable business insights.
- Apply statistical and analytical methods to support business decisions.
- Assess data quality, completeness, and fitness for purpose.
- Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations for stakeholders.
- Use generative AI tools, such as Claude Code or GH Copilot, to accelerate SQL, dbt, and Power BI development, and share what works with the team.

  

**Data Products and Business Intelligence**

- Design and develop dashboards, visualizations, and analytical products using Power BI, Qlik, and other relevant tools.
- Create intuitive data experiences that enable stakeholders to act on insights.
- Contribute to reusable data products, shared metrics, and standardized analytics solutions.
- Support use cases across customer segmentation, marketing effectiveness, revenue analytics, retention, and predictive analytics.

  

**Data Modeling and Technical Delivery**

- Understand source systems, warehouse structures, data relationships, business definitions, and analytical data models.
- Create or adapt analytical data models and transformations for individual use cases.
- Work with platforms such as Snowflake and tools such as dbt.
- Investigate analytical data issues and partner with Data Engineering on production pipelines and shared models.

  

**End to End Solution Ownership**

- Own assigned data use cases from initial business problem through delivery, validation, and adoption.
- Act as solution lead and coordinate contributions from Data Engineering, Data Science, BI, AI, and other specialists.
- Proactively manage dependencies, risks, and data availability constraints.
- Share knowledge and reduce dependency on individual experts through office hours, training, self-service reporting, and recurring metric deep dives.

  

**Data Quality and Governance**

- Apply established data standards, definitions, governance requirements, and documentation practices.
- Identify data quality risks and coordinate resolution with appropriate owners.
- Maintain awareness of security, privacy, responsible data usage, and enterprise governance requirements.
- Support traceability and consistency of important business metrics and analytical outputs.

  

**Location:** This is a REMOTE role, with a preference for those located in or near the Eastern Time Zone due to regular collaboration with global colleagues in Germany. Candidates must be able to sustainably accommodate the working hours required for effective cross-time-zone collaboration.

**What will you need to succeed?**

**Experience & Business Partnership:**

- 7+years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, analytics engineering, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
- Demonstrated experience partnering with business stakeholders to translate business problems into analytical requirements and pragmatic solutions.
- Proven track record of uncovering insights through data mining and analysis, and applying business acumen to recommend actions that shaped decisions.

  

**Data & Analytics Expertise:**

- Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, common table expressions, window functions, and analytical transformations.
- Strong analytical and data modeling capabilities, including experience working with relational data, transformations, data quality, validation, and complex datasets.
- Experience developing dashboards, visualizations, or analytical applications using Power BI, Qlik, or comparable BI platforms.

  

**Platforms & Technology:**

- Hands-on experience with Salesforce or other CRM data, such as opportunities, accounts, leads, and campaigns.
- Experience working with a modern cloud data platform such as Snowflake, Databricks, Azure, AWS, or comparable technologies.

  

**Core Competencies:**

- Ability to independently investigate business and data problems and deliver analytical solutions with limited supervision.
- Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently and navigate ambiguity.

  

**You'll Thrive Even More If You Also Bring:**

- Experience working in smaller or lean analytics teams where individuals are responsible for multiple stages of the analytics lifecycle, from requirements gathering through solution delivery
- Experience supporting Marketing Analytics or other commercial functions such as Sales, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, or Commercial Finance.
- Hands on experience with Snowflake and dbt or comparable data transformation tooling.
- Python experience for data analysis, automation, or analytical development.
- Experience with go-to-market systems data, such as marketing automation, attribution, and customer success platforms.
- Familiarity with dimensional modeling, semantic data models, and data pipelines.
- Exposure to machine learning, predictive analytics, segmentation, AI enabled use cases, or enterprise data governance.
- Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted analytics, predictive modeling, experimentation frameworks, or model performance evaluation.
- Experience supporting SaaS, subscription, software, or recurring revenue business models.

  

**What Does Success Look Like?**

Within the first 6 to 12 months, the successful candidate should be able to:

- Become a trusted analytics partner capable of independently leading complex business initiatives from discovery through business impact.
- Build trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels, from field teams to senior leadership, in one or more commercial domains.
- Handle a steady flow of business requests with insights and recommendations that stakeholders act on.
- Turn loosely defined business problems into structured, executable analytical solutions.
- Deliver reliable analysis, data models, and BI solutions with limited day to day support.
- Navigate SI AMS data structures and identify appropriate data sources, models, and dependencies.
- Become a trusted owner of business logic, data investigation, and analytical delivery within assigned domains.
- Collaborate effectively with Data Engineering, Data Science, AI, and other specialist functions.
- Produce clear documentation covering business definitions, data sources, analytical logic, lineage, and solution design.
- Contribute to a scalable and resilient Data & AI environment through strong ownership, reusable solutions, and knowledge sharing.
- Define measurable success criteria and experimentation approaches to evaluate business initiatives, campaigns, and AI-driven solutions

  

**Why you’ll love working for Siemens!**

- Freedom and a healthy work- life balance– Embrace our flexible work environment with flex hours, telecommuting and digital workspaces.
- Solve the world’s most significant problems – Be part of exciting and innovative projects.
- Engaging, challenging, and fast evolving, cutting edge technological environment.
- Opportunities to advance your career and mentorship programs on a local and global scale.
- Competitive total rewards package.
- Profit sharing available.
- Rewarding vacation entitlement with the opportunity to buy and sell your vacation depending on your lifestyle.
- Contribute to our social responsibility initiatives focused on access to education, access to technology and sustaining communities and make a positive impact on the community.
- Participate in our celebrations, social events and offsite business events.
- Opportunities to contribute your innovative ideas and get paid for them!
- Employee perks and discounts.
- Diversity and inclusivity focused.

Siemens is proud to be an eight-time award winner of Canada’s Top 100 Employers, Canada’s Greenest Employers 2026 and Canada’s Top Employers for Young People 2026.

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

**Advanced Data Analyst - FC Live Service Forecasting**

Our FC Data & Analytics team is looking for an Advanced Analyst to join our group, leading forecasting and performance modelling for FC’s live service business. Reporting to a Senior Analytics Manager, you will be part of a growing team providing data and insights around player behaviour and live content performance within the FC franchise. We’re looking for someone who combines strong quantitative forecasting expertise with business intuition, bringing the ability to translate historical trends, player behaviour, and live content strategies into actionable projections that inform decision-making. This role sits at the intersection of analytics, strategy, and live service operations - helping shape how FC plans and measures performance at scale.

  
  

**What you'll do on our team:**

  

- Own the forecasting framework that underpins performance measurement, planning, and strategic decision-making across FC’s live service business.
  
- Employ an extensive toolkit of financial modelling techniques, time series analysis, and a deep knowledge of their use cases.
  
- Develop a robust model that projects our live service funnel metrics to a high degree of fidelity, incorporating player behaviour, in-game content, and macroeconomic trends.
  
- Collaborate with partners across Product Management, Finance, and Commercial teams to align on projections, and keep the business updated on how our latest live service performance impacts our model’s assumptions.
  
- Establish scalable forecasting processes that enable us to work with our cross-functional partners to efficiently & effectively refine our projections over time.
  
- Lead presentations to diverse audiences including senior and executive level management, distilling complex model results into clear insights & recommendations.
  
- Run risk and opportunity scenarios based on live content plans, new feature additions, and other potential changes in the FC product.
  
- Mentor and collaborate with other analysts in order to collaboratively develop our forecasts, working together to drive evolutions in our modelling in this space.
  

  

**What we're looking for:**

  

- A degree in a quantitative discipline (Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, or similar)
  
- 7+ years of experience in a data-driven role performing quantitative analysis with big data to help guide decisions
  
- 4+ years of experience developing financial/product performance projections and forecasts using various modelling techniques
  
- Strong experience in statistical and/or time series modelling for predictive purposes
  
- Expertise in SQL and working with large-scale, complex datasets
  
- Proficient in analyzing large datasets using programmatic tools (e.g. Python, R)
  
- Experience with data visualization software (e.g. Tableau, PowerBI)
  
- Strong capabilities in project management processes
  
- Very comfortable presenting analysis in an executive facing environment

Lyft is hiring a Senior Financial Data Analyst to lead the Reporting sub-team within Finance Data & Insights, including people management of a small team of analysts. This sub-team is core to ensuring all key Run the Business (RTB) financial reports are complete, accurate, and operationally reliable on a day-to-day basis. The mandate is two-fold: build repeatable systems, playbooks, and documented workflows that reduce reactive work, and own the primary stakeholder relationships for RTB work across teams. This is a high-visibility role that combines hands-on ownership of critical reporting with team direct people leadership and process-building.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

- Own all RTB and Compliance reporting (tax, airports, audit requests, etc.), ensuring accuracy, completeness, and operational reliability
- Directly manage a team of entry-level and mid-level analysts, including hiring, performance reviews, and career development
- Build and maintain process documentation, checklists, and operational playbooks that make reporting workflows repeatable and resilient
- Receive and operationalize reports stabilized by Finance Data Products, integrating them into day-to-day RTB reporting operations
- Reduce fire-drill, ad-hoc response patterns by replacing them with documented, recurring workflows and automation
- Identify and drive automation opportunities across RTB reporting processes to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and further reduce ad-hoc work
- Own primary stakeholder relationships for RTB work, serving as the go-to point of contact across teams

- Proactively identify risks, gaps, and opportunities for improvement within RTB reporting and drive initiatives to address them

**Experience:**

- BA/BS with 5+ years of experience in finance, accounting, business, consulting, or analytics

- Prior formal people-management experience required — including hiring, performance reviews, and career development.
- Proven ability to build process documentation, playbooks, and operational workflows that scale

Ensures current epidemiological information is readily available for public health planning and surveillance initiatives by extracting, manipulating, analyzing, and interpreting health-related statistical data. Provides analytical and technical support in database management, health data analysis, and health data mapping to public health staff for departmental programs, cross-departmental working groups, and community agencies. Assembles and transforms data into appropriate format for analysis to aid in the understanding of the geographic influence of social, economic, and environmental factors on human health.

**Senior Business Analyst, Product Data Management**

Emmerson Packaging is a third-generation family-owned company. We are an industry leader in flexible packaging solutions, and we love what we do! We pride ourselves on meeting and exceeding the highest quality standards in everything we do, including adding talented people to our team! This passion and pride have won us the distinction of being named one of Canada’s Best Managed companies for 17 years running.

This is a full-time, temporary position (salaried 1-year term, with renewal anticipated through go-live and hypercare).

**Our Values say it best:**

- We enhance our lives by helping others succeed
- We care about our clients, each other, and our communities
- We are responsible for the outcome of our actions
- We strive to do the right thing, even if it costs us

**JOB SUMMARY**:

The Senior Business Analyst, Product Data Management owns product and master data design for our S/4HANA program: how Emmerson Packaging defines, structures, governs and converts the data behind every film, bag and roll we make. Clean product data is the foundation for costing, planning, quality and pricing, and this role makes sure it is right on Day 1. A core goal is moving from decentralized data ownership to a centralized, standardized governance model.

Emmerson Packaging is moving from SAP ECC 6.0 to S/4HANA through a RISE with SAP Brownfield system conversion, and we are hiring experienced business analysts to help lead the design. The program is run by our Program Management Office (PMO) and is the company’s primary strategic initiative. Phase 0 discovery with our systems integrator partners runs through December 2026, followed by Prepare, Explore, Realize, Deploy and Run. You will shape a Day 1 design for a real manufacturing business, work directly with business process owners in 24 departments, and have visible impact on how the company runs for the next decade.

**POSITION DETAILS**:

- **Reports to:** ERP Program Manager and PMO Lead
- **Team:** S/4HANA implementation team within the PMO, working with business process owners, SMEs and systems integrator consultants
- **Location:** Hybrid, Atlantic Canada or Ontario, with travel to our Amherst, NS and Belleville, ON plants
- **Travel:** Up to 25%, heavier during workshops, testing and cutover

**JOB TASKS**:

- Leads fit-to-standard workshops for product master data across sales, purchasing, production, quality, costing and plant maintenance views
- Designs the material master in S/4HANA: material types, units of measure and conversions, classification and characteristics, and batch management
- Owns our existing variant configuration (LO-VC) models through conversion: configurable materials, characteristics and classes, dependencies, variant tables, configuration profiles, super BOMs and routings, and variant pricing. Validates them in S/4HANA, cleans up obsolete logic, and assesses the business case and timing for moving to Advanced Variant Configuration (AVC)
- Owns our SAP Document Management (DMS) through conversion: document types, document info records, object links to materials and BOMs, versioning, status workflow and content storage, including specs, print artwork, drawings and certificates
- Defines bills of materials, routings/master recipes, work centers and production versions with Production Planning and Quality leads
- Leads customer/vendor integration (CVI) to Business Partner: pre-conversion cleansing, number ranges, BP roles and groupings, and post-conversion validation
- Builds and leads a centralized master data governance model: clear ownership, data and naming standards, create/change workflows and quality checks in standard S/4HANA, to de-risk data before conversion and keep it clean after
- Leads master data conversion readiness: profiling, cleansing, deduplication and archiving of obsolete records before conversion, with reconciliation and sign-off by data owners
- Resolves known data issues, such as footage-to-weight conversions for film products, as Day 1 design requirements
- Writes functional specifications for data-related reports, interfaces and validations

We believe the best of this industry is still ahead - and we intend to lead it there. Come join us.

Reporting to the Manager, Data Reporting & Analytics, the Master Data Analyst will work within the enterprise master data team to manage and govern master data across Sage X3, the organization’s primary ERP, and connected operational, cultivation, quality, planning, maintenance, medical, and analytics platforms. The candidate will support the business by ensuring master data is accurate, complete, consistent, and efficiently maintained across the enterprise application landscape.

**Responsibilities**

  

- Create, maintain, enter, and upload enterprise master data accurately and within established service levels across Sage X3 and connected systems.
- Manage master data throughout its lifecycle, including creation, modification, activation, deactivation, archival, and periodic review.
- Understand how master data is created, mapped, transformed, synchronized, and consumed across Sage X3 and connected systems, including Elevated Signals, PlantIT, Ample Organics, Lifecharts, Kinaxis Maestro, Ensur, Fiix, Snowflake, Power BI, and Tableau.
- Develop, implement, and maintain internal controls and best practices for creating and maintaining master data across Sage X3 and connected enterprise systems.
- Maintain strict adherence to Master Data Management (MDM) governance, including established data standards, ownership, controls, approval workflows, and change procedures.
- Apply enterprise data standards to prevent downstream transaction, integration, reporting, and control issues.
- Collaborate with Data Owners and Data Stewards to resolve data-quality issues, confirm requirements, and maintain enterprise standards.
- Monitor data-quality measures, investigate exceptions and duplicates, coordinate corrective action, and support root-cause analysis of recurring master data issues.
- Collaborate with Support Centre departments to maintain centralized data elements and aligned business definitions.
- Use advanced Excel capabilities for data analysis, validation, reconciliation, and bulk-data preparation.
- Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot operational and business reports for Sage X3 using Crystal Reports as a supporting responsibility, including validating report outputs against underlying master and transactional data.
- Perform periodic audits to verify master data accuracy, integrity, completeness, and compliance with established standards.
- Support system implementations, integrations, acquisitions, organizational changes, and other initiatives through data mapping, cleansing, validation, migration, reconciliation, testing, and cutover activities.
- Resolve end-user service requests and incidents within established service-level expectations.
- Other duties as assigned.

**Experience**

- 2+ years of experience with enterprise master data and ERP systems, preferably Sage X3, with exposure to connected operational platforms and the Order to Cash (O2C), Procure to Pay (P2P), Plan to Manufacture (PTM), or Record to Report (R2R) business streams.
- Experience applying MDM governance, data-quality, and data-stewardship practices in a controlled or regulated environment.
- Experience with data cleansing, mapping, validation, migration, and reconciliation.
- Familiarity with item, customer, vendor, bill of material, location, and organizational master data.
- Advanced Excel skills for data manipulation, analysis, validation, and reconciliation.
- Experience with Crystal Reports or similar enterprise reporting tools is preferred, including report development, modification, troubleshooting, and data validation.
- Familiarity with internal controls, audit evidence, segregation of duties, ticketing processes, and service-level expectations.
- Ability to translate business requirements and data issues between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Strong organizational and project-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple competing deliverables.
- Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
- Proven ability to build effective working relationships with Data Owners, Data Stewards, business stakeholders, and technical teams.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to communicate effectively across all levels of the organization.

- Demonstrate strong teamwork and collaboration skills.

- Communicate effectively both in writing and verbally.
